title: Atharvaveda
author: The Veda of daily life
intro: The Veda of everyday life: healing, home, kingship and the Earth. Its twelfth book opens with the Bhumi Sukta, 63 verses in praise of Mother Earth, including the famous माता भूमिः पुत्रो अहं पृथिव्याः. Five of its best-known verses are given here.
note: Selected verses of the Bhumi Sukta (Atharvaveda 12.1). The Mandukya Upanishad on this site also belongs to the Atharvaveda. Vedic accent marks are not shown.
